snippet.title: Trailer for a game prototype: Relics of Aurelia
snippet.description:
Play the free demo here:
https://plexicrafts.itch.io/relicsofaurelia

Relics of Aurelia is an isekai fantasy adventure game with JRPG and Metroidvania elements.

It's inspired by my love for many different games but most prominently: 
Dragon Quest
Zelda: Link's Awakening
and Monster Hunter

The song in this trailer is called "Onward" and is a work in progress (as is much of the game itself). It's the only original track currently in the game with other music being placeholder.

I'd love to know what you think of the game, page, or music, so feel free to toss me a comment and I'll be happy to take in all feedback :D
